fields.title: DIC price evidence should use the actual primary award
fields.evidence: The cited 180–350k purchase indicator was an AI estimate from an aggregator. The related NIST award 1333ND26PNB30149, dated 2026-09-22, lists total value USD 530000. This is a different procurement scope from a rented or partner-supplied experiment.
fields.proposed_fix: Replace the weak purchase-price reference with the primary award and scope distinction. Do not convert it directly into a revised rental or total test cost.

claim: DIC price evidence should use the actual primary award
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
